$comment: What scripts/brand_mail.py has sent, one record per message, written by the script ("uncertain" before the message is handed to the server, "sent" once the server accepts it) and committed by .github/workflows/brand-mail.yml. repliesRecorded is written by hand when a reply is read and recorded in the venue's note: {venue, recordedAt, reading: YES | NO | NOT ANSWERED, coveredMessageIds: the Message-ID of every message the reading covers}. An empty sent list means nothing has been sent.
